# Copilot Instructions

This module wraps a single resource: `azurerm_express_route_gateway`. It has no sibling
resources (no private endpoint, no secret/backup/autoshutdown support) because the
underlying Azure resource needs none of those — it always attaches to an existing Virtual
Hub (`virtual_hub_id`), supplied by the caller as a plain input.

## Commands

```bash
terraform init -backend=false
terraform fmt -recursive
terraform validate
terraform test
```

To plan against the ESLZ example (requires a real `virtual_hub_id`, not just mocks):

```bash
cd ESLZ && terraform init && terraform plan -var-file=ExpressRouteGateway.tfvars
```

## Naming convention

`{env4}-{group}-{project}-{userDefinedString}-ergw`, lowercased and stripped of any character
not matching `[0-9a-z-]`, truncated to 64 chars total. Implemented in [name.tf](name.tf);
resource group name resolution (accepts either a `resource_groups` map key or a full resource
ID) is in [locals.tf](locals.tf).

## Design patterns present in this module

- Every optional top-level argument uses `try(var.express_route_gateway.<attr>,
  <registry_default>)`.
- No nested blocks — `azurerm_express_route_gateway` has no optional sub-blocks to model as
  `dynamic`.
- `tags = merge(var.tags, try(var.express_route_gateway.tags, {}))` — never invent tags,
  always merge the caller's.

## File layout

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `terraform.tf` | Provider requirements |
| `variables.tf` | Module inputs |
| `name.tf` | Naming convention locals |
| `locals.tf` | Resource group name resolution |
| `module.tf` | The `azurerm_express_route_gateway` resource |
| `outputs.tf` | Module outputs |
| `ESLZ/ExpressRouteGateway.tf` | Wrapper consumed verbatim by an ESLZ blueprint |
| `ESLZ/ExpressRouteGateway.tfvars` | Example/reference tfvars |
| `tests/express_route_gateway.tftest.hcl` | `terraform test` coverage |
| `test/live/` | Real-Azure-resource CI harness (see its own `README.md`) |

## Agent guidance checklist

- Read `variables.tf` → `locals.tf` → the target file before editing.
- Check `ESLZ/ExpressRouteGateway.tf` before changing this module's variable interface — it's
  copied verbatim into consuming ESLZ blueprints and must stay in sync.
- Check naming side-effects before changing how `env`/`group`/`project`/`userDefinedString`
  are combined — any change here changes every existing gateway's Azure resource name.
- Keep edits outside the `<!-- BEGIN_TF_DOCS -->` / `<!-- END_TF_DOCS -->` markers in
  `README.md` — that section is regenerated by CI.
- Run `terraform fmt -recursive` after any `.tf` edit.
- Add a new `run` block to `tests/express_route_gateway.tftest.hcl` for any new optional
  argument.
